statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-25260 references upstream bug https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=31058, fixed by commit 373f5212677235fc3ca6068b887111554790f944, which adds a bounds check in arm_machine_flag_name and was first released in elfutils 0.191. Every published DHI elfutils package is built from elfutils 0.192, whose backends/arm_machineflagname.c contains that check. Upstream notes on the bug that the CVE's description, a NULL pointer dereference in handle_verdef, does not match it. We ran the bug's reproducer and all 41 inputs from the reproducer archive linked from the CVE (https://github.com/schsiung/fuzzer_issues/issues/1) through eu-readelf -a from the current arm64 package, and none of them crashed. The fixed version is the lowest published build in the current version scheme.
